cause: The astronomy-db database container exited at 11:42:07 and has not restarted. product-catalog cannot open a database connection, so product listing and search fail and the frontend shows errors.

evidence.claim: product-catalog logs connection failures to the database starting at 11:42:08.
evidence.quote: failed to connect to database: connection refused

evidence.claim: Error traces start in product-catalog at the database query span.
product-catalog error rate rose from 0% to 100% in the window.

alternatives_considered.why_rejected: Its container is running and healthy; only its database calls fail.

alternatives_considered.hypothesis: Network problem between product-catalog and the database.
alternatives_considered.why_rejected: The database container is not running at all, which explains the refused connections.

limitations: I did not read the database's own logs, so why it exited is unknown.
